headword: {年齢制限|ねんれいせいげん}

definitions.explanation: A minimum or maximum age requirement for participation, entry, purchase, or other activities. Common in contexts like alcohol purchase, movie ratings, job applications, and event entry.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{年齢制限|ねんれいせいげん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is an age restriction for this event.

examples.japanese: {年齢制限|ねんれいせいげん}⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{参加|さんか}→参加：02498_sanka⟧⟦できます→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Anyone can participate regardless of age.

examples.japanese: ⟦{応募|おうぼ}→応募：03014_oubo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{年齢制限|ねんれいせいげん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧18{歳以上|さいいじょう}65{歳未満|さいみまん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なっています→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The age restriction for applications is 18 or older and under 65.

notes:
{年齢制限|ねんれいせいげん} is a compound of ⟦{年齢|ねんれい}→年齢：01490_nenrei⟧ (age) and ⟦{制限|せいげん}→制限：03375_seigen⟧ (restriction). It refers to any minimum or maximum age requirement imposed on an activity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {年齢制限|ねんれいせいげん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: there is an age limit
- {年齢制限|ねんれいせいげん}なし: no age limit
- {年齢制限|ねんれいせいげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設|もう}ける→設ける：14220_moukeru⟧: to set an age limit
- {年齢制限|ねんれいせいげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撤廃|てっぱい}→撤廃：12911_teppai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to abolish the age limit

USAGE:
Very common in job postings (⟦{求人|きゅうじん}→求人：04690_kyuujin⟧), event rules, product labels (⟦{酒類|しゅるい}→酒類：21058_shurui⟧ and tobacco purchasing), and online services. In Japan, the legal drinking and smoking age is 20 (⟦{二十歳|はたち}→二十歳：02933_hatachi⟧), so {年齢制限|ねんれいせいげん} often appears in those contexts.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{年齢|ねんれい}→年齢：01490_nenrei⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧: age verification
- ⟦{対象|たいしょう}→対象：03393_taishou⟧⟦{年齢|ねんれい}→年齢：01490_nenrei⟧: target age range
